verdict.rationale: Grok Build is documented as a coding agent with a TUI for coding with agents. Plan mode explores the codebase and drafts a plan before editing, sessions snapshot and restore all touched files, and a todo list tracks multi-step work. These together imply plain-language, multi-file implementation, and a hands-on user reports impressive, fast performance on real projects. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party description or example of implementing a feature or fixing a bug across multiple files (the sample prompts are only explanatory), and independent evidence of multi-file edit quality.
